candidate.title: Universe benchmark omits explicit cash settlements
candidate.severity: medium if the universe benchmark is contractually settlement-inclusive
candidate.confidence: high source omission, medium intended-policy interpretation
candidate.reason: run_backtest applies supplied delisting settlements to portfolio holdings at engine.py:427-452, but constructs the universe equal-weight benchmark solely from close ratios and prior-close membership at engine.py:568-571. CLI records the same supplied settlements and can make universe information ratio a portfolio verdict rule. README documents reliable settlement data as required for credible historical delisting performance but does not explicitly define whether the universe benchmark is a price-only proxy.
candidate.expected: Benchmark policy must be explicit. If the universe benchmark represents investable gross universe performance under the same observed delisting events, event-date settlement returns must enter it. If intentionally price-only, reports and validation must identify that limitation.
candidate.actual: Settlement events are not an input to benchmark construction. A member with no post-event close produces no settlement loss in the benchmark while the portfolio reflects it.
candidate.control: No event, or a settlement equal to the last valid close, should leave the benchmark return unchanged.
